title: Table reservation
passage:
Could we move our reservation to seven thirty?
A. Let me check whether a table is available.
B. The table is made of wood.
C. I moved here last year.
passageZh:
我們能把訂位改到七點半嗎？
A. 讓我確認是否還有空桌。
B. 桌子是木製的。
C. 我去年搬來這裡。
